_comment: Known feature-E2E failures. Each entry: { case, gap, reason }. Shrink-only: a new failure fails CI, and an entry whose case now passes must be removed in the same change.

sales-invoice.reason: Lost update: two operators load the same voucher, the first saves, the stale second save answers 200 and overwrites it (line 70,000 instead of 65,000). editSale reads no version token; tracked by N51 (version tokens on every update/delete, waiting on decision D17).

purchase-invoice.reason: Lost update on purchase too: the stale second save answers 200 and overwrites the first (no version token; N51).

sales-return.reason: The return prices the line on fine weight with paise (58,465.80); the desktop prices on SL_AMT_TYPE (net + ghat) in whole rupees, 63,609 (TR_SALE_RTN.cs:4914-4931, 4955, 4985).
Stored ITM_AMT/NET_AMT/TOT_AMT follow the fine basis with paise; the desktop stores 61,234 + 2,375 and a whole-rupee total of 65,517 (TR_SALE_RTN.cs:16405).
The second delete of an already deleted return answers 500 (PersistedVoucherNotFoundError is not mapped by run()).
POST /sales-returns does not pass the user, so SL_DATA.MAIN_USER is blank; the desktop stores DC_Main.MCo_User (TR_SALE_RTN.cs:9966, 12908).
The delete writes the tenant id as DELETE_DATA.DELETE_USER; the desktop writes DC_Main.MCo_User (TR_SALE_RTN.cs:15076).

purchase-return.reason: The return previews 56,090.80 + 2,375 = 58,465.80 with paise; the desktop rounds the item and labour amounts and the bill to whole rupees, 58,466 and a 60,220 total (TR_KR_ISU.cs:4015, 4028, 6522-6528).
Stored ITM_AMT/NET_AMT/TOT_AMT keep paise (56,090.80 / 58,465.80 / 60,219.77); the desktop stores 56,091 / 58,466 / 60,220.

Orig Purchase Book is a required select with no preselection (two purchase books), so the browser blocks Save on a free-standing return; the desktop needs only a party and a voucher number (TR_KR_ISU.cs:4986-4999).
The Purchase Return save button carries no data-save-mnemonic, so Alt+S does nothing; the desktop button is &Save (TR_KR_ISU.cs:2330).
The register requires BOOK_TBL_NAME 'PR_DATA' and seedCompany leaves it NULL for PRT, so it lists no return; the desktop sets it for PURC RETURN books (MS_UPDATE.cs:7849).
